title: test(imap): unit tests for IMAP4REV2 and NAMESPACE in capability_list
description:
Write unit tests for the updated capability_list() in crates/imap/src/session/commands.rs. Tests must have independent oracles — expected values come from the RFC wire format, not from calling capability_list() itself.

Tests to write (in the existing #[cfg(test)] mod at bottom of commands.rs):
1. capability_list_includes_imap4rev2_plaintext: call capability_list(false); assert the result contains a capability that displays as "IMAP4rev2"; assert it does NOT display as "IMAP4rev1".
2. capability_list_includes_imap4rev2_tls: same for capability_list(true).
3. capability_list_includes_namespace: call capability_list(false); assert result contains Capability::Namespace (or a capability displaying as "NAMESPACE").
4. capability_list_does_not_include_status_size: assert no capability displays as "STATUS=SIZE" (deferred).
5. capability_data_roundtrip: call capability_data(true); encode to bytes using imap-codec ResponseCodec; assert wire bytes contain b"IMAP4rev2" and b"NAMESPACE" as substrings.

Oracle: RFC 9051 §6.1.1 defines IMAP4rev2 as the exact capability string; RFC 2342 §5 defines NAMESPACE. The wire encoding of capability strings is the capability name with no quotes.

Acceptance: cargo test -p stoa-imap passes with all 5 tests green; no test modifies implementation files.
